department: Faculty of Environment and Natural Resources (Examination Office)

deadline.value: The faculty page sets no application deadline. Applying early lets the formal requirements be checked first.
deadline.quote: Submitting the application as doctoral student at an early stage guarantees you that the formal prerequisites of your doctoral studies can be checked right at the beginning.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the faculty page.

supervisor.value: A signed doctoral supervision agreement must accompany the application for admission as a doctoral candidate.
supervisor.quote: One of the required documents listed in the application form is the Doctoral Supervision Agreement

funding.value: The faculty page states no funding rule.

entry_route.value: The main prerequisite is an especially qualified Master's or Diploma degree.
entry_route.quote: The most important prerequisite for pursuing a doctorate is an especially qualified Master or Diploma university degree.

notes: Faculty-wide page. Geosciences and other ENR fields are not verified on a separate page, so no earth record is saved.
